task.name: component IO core: two-way value protocol
task.prompt: Build the core of a universal two-way data layer. Any component with data-zui-id is addressable. Outbound (UI->host): emit {id,kind,value} on the 'value' channel on every user change; zui.values(scope) snapshot; zui.field(id) getter; per-id local subscribe zui.bind(id,fn); [data-zui-submit] buttons emit 'submit' with the enclosing form's values. Inbound (host->UI): auto-handle 'set' {id,value}, 'set-many' {id:value}, and 'query' (reply with value/values). zui.set(id,value) writer. Scroll position reads throttled. No echo on programmatic set (loop-safe).
task.requirements: One two-way value protocol: any [data-zui-id] component is readable via zui.values()/zui.field() and writable via zui.set(); user changes emit {id,kind,value} on 'value'; host can push 'set'/'set-many'/'query'; [data-zui-submit] emits 'submit' with form values; programmatic set is loop-safe. Verified by a 19-assertion headless self-test.
task.notes: Added the component IO core to core/js/zui.js. Public API: zui.values(scope) snapshot, zui.field(id), zui.set(id,value | {id:value}), zui.bind(id,fn) local subscribe. Kinds + adapters: text (input/textarea), boolean (checkbox + aria-pressed toggle), select (native + .zui-select), progress (0-100 + 'indeterminate'), button (out: {event:'click'}; in: 'click' w/ flash, {busy|disabled|pressed|label}), scroll (top/left + topPct/leftPct, on-scroll export throttled 100ms, scrollTo in). Outbound 'value' message per change + zui.bind handlers. Inbound auto-handlers: 'set', 'set-many', 'query' (replies 'value'/'values'). [data-zui-submit] button -> 'submit' {form, values} scoped to nearest [data-zui-form]. Programmatic set() never re-emits (loop-safe); a programmatic button 'click' does fire the real handler by design. .zui-btn--flash style. tests/io-selftest.html (19 assertions, all pass) wired into build.ps1 -Config test via headless Chrome/Edge.

task.name: ZML: XML-style front end for the UI language
task.prompt: Add an alternative angle-bracket syntax (ZML) to the zslc compiler alongside the existing brace syntax. Front end auto-detects: a source that starts with '<' parses as ZML tags, otherwise as brace ZSL; both build the same AST and feed the same html/csharp/cpp backends. Support element nesting, attributes (incl. bind/source/on, boolean flags, x=\"true\"), text content, self-closing tags, <!-- --> comments, and <state>/<on><emit|set/></on>. task.requirements: zslc compiles both a '<'-leading ZML file and a brace ZSL file to identical output; ZML supports nesting, attributes, flags, text, self-closing, comments and state/on; example .zml compiles on all backends; tests pass.
